description: This file contains type guard functions for various data types and component nodes used in a UI rendering framework. It includes checks for primitive value types, component nodes, and resolved component types, facilitating runtime type safety and validation.

methods.name: export function isValueMap(value: unknown): value is ValueMap { isValueMap
methods.description: Checks if the given value conforms to the ValueMap type by verifying the presence of the 'key' property.

methods.name: export function isPath(key: string, value: unknown): value is string { isPath
methods.description: Checks if the provided key is 'path' and the value is a string.

methods.name: export function isObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> { isObject
methods.description: Determines if the value is a non-null object that is not an array.

methods.name: export function isComponentArrayReference( isComponentArrayReference
methods.description: Checks if the value is a ComponentArrayReference, which is an object containing 'explicitList' or 'template'.

methods.name: function isStringValue(value: unknown): value is StringValue { isStringValue
methods.description: Determines if the value is a StringValue, checking specific properties like 'path' or 'literal'.

methods.description: Checks if the value is a NumberValue with properties like 'path' or 'literal'.

methods.name: function isBooleanValue(value: unknown): value is BooleanValue { isBooleanValue
methods.description: Checks if the value is a BooleanValue with properties like 'path' or 'literal'.

methods.name: function isAnyComponentNode(value: unknown): value is AnyComponentNode { isAnyComponentNode
methods.description: Determines if the value is a generic component node, verifying required base properties.

methods.name: export function isResolvedAudioPlayer( isResolvedAudioPlayer
methods.description: Checks if the object matches the ResolvedAudioPlayer type, specifically for objects with 'url' as StringValue.

methods.name: export function isResolvedCard(props: unknown): props is ResolvedCard { isResolvedCard

methods.name: export function isResolvedCheckbox(props: unknown): props is ResolvedCheckbox { isResolvedCheckbox

methods.name: export function isResolvedColumn(props: unknown): props is ResolvedColumn { isResolvedColumn
methods.description: Checks if the object is a ResolvedColumn, ensuring 'children' is an array of AnyComponentNode.

methods.name: export function isResolvedDateTimeInput( isResolvedDateTimeInput
methods.description: Checks if the object is a ResolvedDateTimeInput with 'value' as StringValue.

methods.name: export function isResolvedDivider(props: unknown): props is ResolvedDivider { isResolvedDivider
methods.description: Simple check if the object is a ResolvedDivider, which can be any object.

methods.name: export function isResolvedImage(props: unknown): props is ResolvedImage { isResolvedImage
methods.description: Checks for ResolvedImage with 'url' as StringValue.

methods.name: export function isResolvedIcon(props: unknown): props is ResolvedIcon { isResolvedIcon
methods.description: Checks for ResolvedIcon with 'name' as StringValue.

methods.name: export function isResolvedList(props: unknown): props is ResolvedList { isResolvedList
methods.description: Validates ResolvedList with 'children' as an array of AnyComponentNode.

methods.name: export function isResolvedModal(props: unknown): props is ResolvedModal { isResolvedModal
methods.description: Checks for ResolvedModal with 'entryPointChild' and 'contentChild' as AnyComponentNode.

methods.name: export function isResolvedMultipleChoice( isResolvedMultipleChoice
methods.description: Verifies ResolvedMultipleChoice with 'selections' property.

methods.name: export function isResolvedRow(props: unknown): props is ResolvedRow { isResolvedRow
methods.description: Checks if 'children' is an array of AnyComponentNode.

methods.name: export function isResolvedSlider(props: unknown): props is ResolvedSlider { isResolvedSlider
methods.description: Determines if 'value' is a NumberValue.

methods.name: function isResolvedTabItem(item: unknown): item is ResolvedTabItem { isResolvedTabItem
methods.description: Validates a ResolvedTabItem with 'title' and 'child'.

methods.name: export function isResolvedTabs(props: unknown): props is ResolvedTabs { isResolvedTabs
methods.description: Checks if the object is ResolvedTabs with 'tabItems' as an array of ResolvedTabItem.

methods.name: export function isResolvedText(props: unknown): props is ResolvedText { isResolvedText
methods.description: Verifies ResolvedText with 'text' as StringValue.

methods.name: export function isResolvedTextField( isResolvedTextField
methods.description: Checks ResolvedTextField with 'label' as StringValue.

methods.name: export function isResolvedVideo(props: unknown): props is ResolvedVideo { isResolvedVideo
methods.description: Checks ResolvedVideo with 'url' as StringValue.
